title: Historical benefits administration spreadsheet import contracts
summary: Blank legacy spreadsheet templates document a structured Employer Portal import interface for employee demographics and FSA/HSA/transit/parking enrollments. One template explicitly identifies Infinisource; the demographic template shares the same import vocabulary and 2018 revision context but its vendor identity is retained as an association rather than asserted independently.

claims.claim: The demographic import requires EmployeeIdentifier, LastName, FirstName, DateOfBirth, AddressLine1, City, State, ZipCode, Username and HireDate, with many additional optional employee/payroll fields.
The demographic import accepts EmploymentStatus values Active, COBRA, LOA, LaidOff, Retired and Terminated; if unspecified, Active is used.
The templates use MMDDCCYY-style date input and state that dashes or slashes are automatically removed.

The benefits enrollment import requires EmployeeIdentifier and ElectionAmount; optional fields include PlanName, EnrollmentEffectiveDate, EmployerContribution, EnrollmentTermDate, PrimaryReimbursement, ElectionAmountIndicator, HDHPCoverageLevel, EnrolledInClaimsExchange and HSATermsFlag.

For HSA accounts the template requires HDHPCoverageLevel of Single or Family and an ElectionAmountIndicator; PlanYear or PerPay may be used for HSA, while PlanYear or PerMonth may be used for MassTransit or Parking.
PrimaryReimbursement values shown are Check, Direct Deposit or Debit Card, and HSATermsFlag is Y/N to indicate acceptance of HSA terms and conditions.

The demographic template contains conflicting recovered instructions for EmployeeIdentifier: one instruction says to use the Employer Portal setup value, while another says the employee Social Security Number may be entered with or without hyphens. This ambiguity is preserved and not resolved by inference.

evidence.note: Two distinct instruction strings occur in the workbook.

unresolved_questions: Whether these 2018 import contracts are still used, have been migrated, or were superseded by later benefits-administration tooling.
Whether the demographic template is definitively Infinisource-branded or only shares the same export/import convention.
Which EmployeeIdentifier instruction is authoritative for the demographic import: portal-configured identifier or SSN?

provenance.notes: No employee rows promoted; blank-template semantics only.
Four normalized-semantic duplicates were observed; this hash is one representative artifact.
